details:
--- Summary ---

Two of my uploaded worlds cannot be entered. Joining them immediately sends me back to

my home world. The client log shows the world file is rejected by the server-side security

analysis with HTTP 403 "File forbidden". This is fully reproducible: two different world

IDs and three file versions were all rejected. At the same time, all of my other worlds

upload and load normally.

--- Affected worlds/files ---

1) World: 宿舍

   World ID: wrld_a92c054c-442b-4c62-819b-d99ce237b94d

   File ID : file_fa3260b2-a1e7-4548-bafd-fa740e9717b6

   - version 1 -> rejected (2026-10-13 18:56, 18:58, 18:59, 19:02, 19:17)

   - version 2 -> rejected (2026-10-13 21:51, 21:52)   [after re-uploading with Update]

2) World: 宿舍 (same content, uploaded as a brand-new world)

   World ID: wrld_bfda033d-d035-4d77-90a5-9b247716f9d5

   File ID : file_373a65ae-3510-4e50-a2eb-bec2e201a54a

   - version 1 -> rejected (2026-10-13 22:31)

--- Client log ---

2026.10.13 21:51:20 Error - [API] [204, 403, Get, -1 https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/analysis/file_fa3260b2-a1e7-4548-bafd-fa740e9717b6/2/security] Abandoning request, because - File forbidden

2026.10.13 21:51:20 Error - World 'wrld_a92c054c-442b-4c62-819b-d99ce237b94d' did not pass initial checks and won't be downloaded: 10

2026.10.13 21:51:21 Error - Error Downloading or Instantiating Custom Scene - 宿舍 - 10

2026.10.13 21:51:21 Error - [Behaviour] Downloading the room failed.

2026.10.13 22:31:41 Error - [API] [180, 403, Get, -1 https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/analysis/file_373a65ae-3510-4e50-a2eb-bec2e201a54a/1/security] Abandoning request, because - File forbidden

2026.10.13 22:31:41 Error - World 'wrld_bfda033d-d035-4d77-90a5-9b247716f9d5' did not pass initial checks and won't be downloaded: 10

2026.10.13 22:31:43 Error - Error Downloading or Instantiating Custom Scene - 宿舍 - 10

2026.10.13 22:31:43 Error - [Behaviour] Downloading the room failed.

--- Client / environment ---

- Client: VRChat Build 2026.3.3p2-1921-15c4a824b2-Release (Steam, PC), launched with --no-vr

- Client Unity: 6000.0.67f1-DWR

- OS: Windows 11 (10.0.22621), GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (D3D11), RAM 16 GB

- Account: DELTA da yo (usr_1f1a410c-2060-4dc0-88b0-43491d1b484b), region jp

- World authoring: Unity 2022.3.22f1, Built-in Render Pipeline

- SDK: com.vrchat.base / com.vrchat.worlds 3.10.4

- World size reported by SDK: 60 MB, platform PC/Windows

--- What I have already ruled out ---

- My account and network are fine: ALL of my other worlds upload and load normally.

- Another world of mine, built in the SAME Unity project with the SAME community prefabs

  (QvPen, VVMW/YTTL video player, Polaroid, Wolfi's-Mirror, VisitorsInformationBoard,

  TIM_QM), works fine. Only this content fails.

- It is not a stuck/corrupted world record: a brand-new world with the same content is

  rejected too (see world 2 above).

- No tracker-module audio files (.mod/.it/.xm/.s3m) anywhere in the project.

- No leaked DLL/EXE in the build (only Editor-only Bakery tooling, excluded from builds).

  No StreamingAssets / Resources folders.

- All 3361 PNG textures verified: valid PNG headers, no bytes appended after IEND.

- All materials resolve to valid shaders (lilToon / Standard); no missing shaders.

- Removing my own Editor helper scripts changes nothing (they are not in the bundle).

--- Request ---

Please check the server-side analysis result for file_fa3260b2-a1e7-4548-bafd-fa740e9717b6

and file_373a65ae-3510-4e50-a2eb-bec2e201a54a and tell me what the scanner flagged, or

whether this is a false positive. I can provide the full client log, the Unity Editor.log,

or the project itself if needed. Thank you.
title: World rejected by server-side analysis (403 "File forbidden"), reproducible on two different world IDs and three file versions; all my other worlds work fineWorld rejected by server-side analysis (403 "File forbidden"), reproducible on two different world IDs and three file versions; all my other worlds work fine
